intro C
  use {0, 1}

  refine ⟨fun A hA => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases Set.mem_coe_subset {0, 1} with ⟨h0, h1⟩

      (try contradiction) <;> simp

    rcases Set.mem_coe_subset {0, 1} with ⟨hB0, hB1⟩
    rcases hA1 with (rflA | rflA | rflA) <;>
    rcases hB1 with (rflB | rflB | rflB) <;>
    (try contradiction) <;>
    (try rcases hA0 with (rflA0 | rflA0 | rflA0) <;>
      try rcases hB0 with (rflB0 | rflB0 | rflB0) <;>
      try contradiction <;> simp)
    · contradiction
    · contradiction
    · contradiction
  · ext x
    simp [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  · intro c
    by_cases hc : c 0 = c 1
    · exact ⟨{0}, by simp, fun x hx => by rcases Set.mem_coe_subset {0, 1} with ⟨h0, h1⟩
        rcases h1 with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;>
        rcases h0 with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;>
        (try contradiction) <;> simp [hc]⟩
    · exact ⟨{1}, by simp, fun x hx => by rcases Set.mem_coe_subset {0, 1} with ⟨h0, h1⟩
        rcases h1 with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;>
        rcases h0 with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;>
        (try contradiction) <;> simp [hc]⟩
